**Amazon's total net sales (revenue) for fiscal year 2024 was $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion)**, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations of its FY2024 Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 [DOC-1].

Supporting excerpt:
- "Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959" (in millions) [DOC-1]

Comparability note: This is a single-period figure drawn directly from Amazon's own FY2024 10-K, on a fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, so no cross-entity, cross-basis, or fiscal-year alignment issues arise. For context, the same filing presents comparatives of $574,785 million for FY2023 and $513,983 million for FY2022 on the same consolidated basis [DOC-1], implying roughly 11.0% year-over-year growth in FY2024.

ANSWER: $637,959 million (~$638.0 billion) in net sales for fiscal year 2024
